import.subtitle: Bulk-load entities from CSV files. Run a dry-run first to preview validation errors without writing anything.
import.entityHint: One file per entity, in the order shown below.
import.filePrompt: Drop a .csv file here, or click to pick one
import.dryRunHint: Recommended for the first pass — the database is rolled back even if everything parses cleanly.
import.exportTemplateHint: Exports the entity as a CSV with the exact column names the importer expects.
import.downloadAllHint: Exports every entity as CSV in a single ZIP archive — logical backup compatible with the bulk import.
import.orderHint: Dependencies between entities — import in this order on a fresh install.

bulk.title: Import multiple files at once
bulk.subtitle: Drop all your CSVs (or a .zip) — entity is detected from the headers and dependency order is honoured automatically.
bulk.dropHint: Multiple files accepted in one shot — up to 50 files, 50 MiB total.
bulk.dryRunHint: Every file is validated together in the same transaction — nothing is written.
bulk.helpDetect: Each CSV is routed to its entity based on the header row (sites, devices, switches…).
bulk.helpOrder: Files are applied in the right order (sites → rooms → vlans → … → links).
bulk.helpTransaction: Everything runs in a single transaction: any error rolls the whole batch back.
bulk.helpZip: A .zip works too — its CSVs are unpacked and imported on the fly.

report.title: Bulk import report

report.partial: {ok} of {total} rows would apply — fix the listed errors and re-run.

report.title: Last import report
report.successDryRun: All {count} rows pass validation. Re-run without dry-run to apply.
report.partial: {ok} of {total} rows would apply — fix the listed errors and re-run.

errors.tooLarge: File exceeds the 10 MiB upload limit.
errors.tooManyFiles: Limit reached: at most {max} files in one batch.

suggestLinks.title: AI link suggestions
suggestLinks.heading: Find missing links
suggestLinks.description: The AI looks at switch names, port labels and notes to propose topology links that aren't recorded yet. You stay in control: accept or reject each suggestion.
suggestLinks.lastRun: Last scan: {persisted} suggestion(s) kept out of {raw} returned · {latency} ms
suggestLinks.emptyDescription: Run a scan and the AI will propose links based on your current inventory.

ai.acceptedToast: Link created from the AI suggestion.
ai.scanDoneToast: {persisted} new suggestion(s) added out of {raw} returned.

askView.title: Ask AI
askView.subtitle: Ask a natural-language question about your inventory — the AI answers from the current data.
askView.placeholder: Ask a question (e.g. how many free ports does SW-CORE-01 have?)
askView.emptyDescription: The assistant reads your live inventory. A few examples to get started:
askView.example1: Which switches have no recorded links?
askView.example2: How many free IPs are left in subnet 10.0.30.0/24?
askView.example3: List the VLANs used on SW-CORE-01.
askView.example4: Which ports are in trunk mode in room R-101?
askView.disabledHint: The AI assistant is disabled. Enable it in Settings → AI to ask questions.

advisor.subtitle: The AI scans your inventory for SPOFs, capacity pressure, segmentation gaps and other weak points.
advisor.emptyDescription: Run the advisor and the AI will review your infrastructure and list its recommendations.
advisor.cleanDescription: The advisor returned nothing on its last run. Re-run periodically to stay up to date.

settings.title: AI assistant
settings.description: Three providers supported: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini. Configuration is environment-driven — edit your .env and restart the backend to switch.
settings.testDescription: Sends a minimal ping to the provider to verify the API key and model before a real scan.
settings.envHint: Update your .env file then restart the backend. Only the key matching AI_PROVIDER is required.

usage.title: AI usage
usage.description: Overview of AI calls over the selected window — count, tokens, estimated cost and average latency.
usage.emptyTitle: No AI calls in this window
usage.emptyDescription: Run the advisor or ask the AI a question to start populating this dashboard.
usage.disclaimer: Cost derived from 2026-05 public list rates (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google). Real billing may differ (cache, batch, region).
